# Note

A free-text note on a person.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `noteId` * | integer | Unique identifier of the note. e.g. `184579` |
| `text` | string or null | The body of the note. e.g. `Great chat! This person will be able to volunteer next year.` |
| `isViewRestricted` | boolean | Whether the note is restricted to certain users in the context. Always false in practice: a restricted note is withheld from API keys entirely rather than returned with the flag set. |
| `category` | object and/or null | The note's category. An uncategorized note reads as the stub `{"noteCategoryId": 0, "name": null}` from GET /people/{vanId}/notes, but as null when the same note arrives through `$expand=notes` on the person. |
| `createdDate` | string (date-time) or null | When the note was created, UTC. Truncated to the minute — the seconds are always 00. e.g. `2026-08-04T17:11:00Z` |
| `isPinned` | boolean | Whether the note is pinned. Always false: POST accepts an `isPinned` field and ignores it, and nothing else in the API sets it. |
| `contactHistory` | object or null | Always null, including for notes created with a `contactHistory` payload and when the list is requested with `$expand=noteDetails`. |

`*` = required.
